explanation: In CODE2, the method m() in class A contains 'B.this.k()', which is an inner class qualified 'this' expression. However, B is not an inner class of A (they are separate top-level classes), so 'B.this' is not valid in class A. This will cause a compilation error because qualified 'this' expressions (EnclosingType.this) are only valid within inner/nested classes to refer to an enclosing instance.
